reasoning: The banana plant shows classic Bunchy Top Virus (BBTV) symptoms: new leaves are abnormally short, narrow, stiff, and upright, crowded together in a rosette/bunched pattern at the crown rather than spreading normally. The overall plant is stunted. This distinguishes it from Panama Disease (which shows yellowing/wilting of outer leaves), Sigatoka diseases (which show leaf spots/streaks), Anthracnose (fruit disease), Cigar End Rot (fruit tip rot), and Cordana Leaf Spot (oval brown leaf lesions).
